reason: The wedding means the house does need painting, and ₹78,000 is not the problem for us. But this service is new in Kochi, so there are no Google reviews and nobody in my WhatsApp groups has used it. I won't hand my home to an unknown crew a few months before the family arrives.
objection: It says 'guaranteed against bubbling and peeling' but never says for how long or what they will do about it. One year? Five? Will they repaint the whole wall or just patch it? If they don't write that down, it isn't a guarantee.
would_change_my_mind: A written guarantee that gives the number of years and says exactly what they will redo, plus two or three finished Turbolux homes in Kochi that I can see or whose owners I can call.
